sequence: lead submission status -> visible confirmation -> automatic destination continuation

leadStatuses.pending: Delivery continues in the background; review may continue
leadStatuses.unconfirmed: Delivery is not claimed; saved review may continue

fallback: If the confirmation controller is unavailable, the existing immediate destination handoff runs.
privacy: Confirmation telemetry includes only lead status, destination type, and automatic or manual continuation; identity, contact, address, and free-form data are excluded.
